author: Karl Rock
description:
Join me inside Lee Market’s vegetable market in Pakistan, located beneath the historic Clock Tower!

While searching for a traditional Balochi suit for my Indian wife, I ended up exploring this bustling local market packed with fresh vegetables, vendors, shoppers and everyday Pakistani life.

This is a quick look inside one of the markets I discovered during my travels through Pakistan.

Watch the full vlog to see whether I managed to find my wife the Balochi suit she wanted!
title: Inside A 100-Year-Old Tower Market! 🇵🇰

author: Karl Rock
description:
Exploring the hidden corners of Pakistan's biggest city feels like a never ending adventure. Just when you think you have seen it all, you stumble upon a sprawling date market tucked away in the chaos.

This city is full of surprises. One minute you are navigating through stacks of dates and the next you are watching local artisans handcrafting miswak, the traditional toothbrushes used for centuries.

There is always something incredible around every corner here. It is a place that refuses to be fully mapped or fully understood, leaving you wanting to explore just one more street.
title: Can you ever truly see all of Karachi?
